current_answer: USDe issuance can change through its replaceable minter even when the token bytecode is fixed. A supplied 11 September Ethereum snapshot resolves core owner/minter, global mint/redeem ceilings, a 5-of-10 Dev Safe, and a 24-hour staking cooldown. Source/provider/runtime checks strengthen the core identity picture, but the measured owner differs from the Safe: upstream controller roles, implementation links and any notice guarantee remain open. Pause, transfer and staking restrictions affect different actions.
summary: Dated control settings, source/deployment cross-checks and the unresolved owner-controller link.
uncertainty: Ethereum core controls at a supplied block; no independent rebuild or complete authority/market assurance.
